name: errdown-mcp
description: MCP server with a fetch tool that returns page content on success and a Cloudflare-compatible structured error (errdown) on failure.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check-pack
scripts.check-pack: node -e "const o=require('child_process').execSync('npm pack --dry-run --json',{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']});const f=JSON.parse(o)[0].files.map(x=>x.path);if(!f.includes('dist/index.js')){console.error('refusing to publish: dist/index.js missing from package');process.exit(1)}console.log('package contents ok: '+f.length+' files')"
